findings.finding: Unknown WEB confirm body after response cookies changed had no concrete new-flow/current-account path; expired text also lacked restart navigation.
findings.resolution: Six-locale restart link /login and separate WEB-unknown current-account link /console. Unknown flow does not claim completion; status failure retains recovery. No server parent-pin or raw-flow-cookie relaxation.

findings.finding: Successful confirm accepted fresh /me for another same-user/company session because only actor IDs were compared.
findings.resolution: Fresh /me must match token-derived csrfToken from confirm as well as actor user/company. Missing/different proof yields intentional FEDERATION_CONFLICT/409 and unknown-result recovery; no onComplete.

findings.finding: Read-only route fixtures used !POST and therefore also accepted PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
findings.resolution: Exact GET checks for reads, exact POST checks for mutations, unexpected traffic aborts and is asserted.

findings.finding: App registers a service worker; worker-owned static traffic could bypass page.route and its unexpected-request inventory. No actual escaped traffic was observed.
findings.resolution: File-local test.use({serviceWorkers:"block"}) for routed F3 fixtures; service-worker behavior explicitly outside these cases.

findings.finding: Existing 800ms deadline test required stdout PID before startup and failed independently on a busy runner.
findings.resolution: Separate 50ms runProcess deadline without stdout assumption from bounded READY<=5s ownProcess cleanup. The ready TERM-ignoring child requires SIGKILL, awaited close and ESRCH. Product wrapper deadlines unchanged.
